newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: PLDT sheds 6.74 pct in early trade.
newsitem.headline: PLDT sheds 6.74 pct in early trade.

text.p: Philippine Long Distance Telephone Co lost 60 pesos, or 6.74 percent, to 830 pesos in early trade on Thursday following the drop in its American Depositary Receipts (ADR), brokers said.

"It just followed the fall of its ADR. But I would buy the stock at this level especially since its a net beneficiary of any weakness in the peso," said Mayenne Catimbang, research head at Magnum International.
Talk of a further weakening peso caused share prices of PLDT to climb to a two-year high last week. PLDT gets the bulk of its revenues from international calls.
PLDT's ADR closed $5/05 lower at $62/01. In early trade, PLDT was the most heavily traded issue with turnover at 90.58 million pesos.
